Definition
[strongly convex set]

1. ch3:4.2A set $S\subset M$ is strongly convex if for any two points $q_1,q_2\in \overline{S}$ there is a minimizing geodesic $\gamma :[0,1]\to M$ (constant-speed, realizing the distance $d(q_1,q_2)$ proportionally to arc length: $d(\gamma (s),\gamma (t))=|s-t|\, d(q_1,q_2)$) whose open-arc interior $\gamma ((0,1))$ lies in $S$, and this joining geodesic is unique among such competitors (pointwise equality on $[0,1]$).
